text_block_list.text:
During training,
North Flight got injured,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer.
It was only mild, so I can get back to training right away.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However, I need to stay focused.
Thinking I could still keep going... I was overestimating myself.
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should apologize... Let's take your time and get that injury healed properly
Sometimes a little overconfidence is necessary!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If anything, Trainer,
you might be the one who needs to rest a bit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You've had such a dejected look on your face this whole time.
Much more so than me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Like I said earlier, I'm totally fine.
...See!

"...I ended up having her worry about me instead.
Pulling myself together, I sat down with her
to rework our future schedule."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll let myself be
just a little overconfident.
Who knows, maybe even now—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
It doesn't come that easily, does it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I won't get overconfident,
and I'll take a good rest to let my injury heal.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Didn't we just talk about not getting overconfident?
choice_data_list: Still, being too pessimistic isn't good either.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that matter,
I'd also like to cast my vote in favor.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, let's stay focused, but stay completely positive.
Go ahead and be overconfident that it'll heal by tomorrow, even.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Shall we discuss tomorrow's
training plan now?

—Perhaps faith really does bring salvation.
The very next day, I was able to begin training with North Flight.
